name: @bitspark/ontos-deixis-projection
description: ontos-over-deixis-v1: the total projection P and exact partial recognizer R between ontos values and Node[Option[Bytes]], on the deixis-pos-v1 position spelling. Additive; the one TypeScript package in ontos that knows deixis exists. Browser-compatible (no Node-only imports). Depends on @bitspark/ontos-core, @bitspark/deixis-core and @bitspark/deixis-pos.
